from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-35c679d1.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) >= 2:
        dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
        dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
        if dr > 0 and dc > 0:
            r, c = points[-1]
            while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
                r += dr
                c += dc
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_program', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo[r][c]=1
target=[[row[:] for row in demo] for _ in [0]][0]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: target[r][c]=2
print('demo match',mod.transform(demo)==target)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
pred=mod.transform(test)
print(pred)
